dedupe_keys.name: water quality measurements supplementary information modelling and set point definition for the development of a joint control system of two interconnected wastewater treatment plants and its application in practice

description: The Berlin Centre of Competence for Water publishes laboratory measurements associated with a joint-control study of two interconnected wastewater treatment plants. Zenodo provides one public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0. The own page identifies daily 24-hour flow-proportional influent and effluent samples, including COD, total suspended solids, total nitrogen, ammonium, nitrate, total phosphorus and phosphate. These time series can calibrate or check wastewater-quality and control simulations, with the related paper describing the practical set-point application. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this measurement package. A limitation is that the landing page does not give sampling dates, plant names, control logs, flow volumes, missing-value rules or uncertainty ranges. The measurements do not alone prove that a proposed joint controller improved discharge quality. The record describes a site application but this draft covers the reusable numeric data, not a separately documented case outcome. The workbook was not downloaded and no concentration was independently checked.
